description: This file implements classes and functions for managing disk cache block files, including creation, opening, validation, growth, and deletion of block files and their headers.

classes.name: BlockHeader
classes.description: Represents the header of a block file, managing block allocation, deallocation, validation, and counters.

classes.name: BlockFiles
classes.description: Manages multiple block files, including creation, opening, validation, growth, and deletion of block files in the disk cache.

methods.name: CreateMapBlock
methods.description: Creates a new map block of a given size within the block file, updating allocation maps and counters.

methods.name: DeleteMapBlock
methods.description: Deletes a map block at a specified index and size, updating counters and allocation maps.

methods.name: UsedMapBlock
methods.description: Checks if a map block at a specified index and size is currently used.

methods.name: FixAllocationCounters
methods.description: Fixes and recalculates the allocation counters based on current allocation map.

methods.name: NeedToGrowBlockFile
methods.description: Determines if the block file needs to be grown to accommodate additional blocks.

methods.name: CanAllocate
methods.description: Checks if the block file can allocate a specified number of blocks.

methods.name: EmptyBlocks
methods.description: Returns the total number of empty blocks.

methods.name: MinimumAllocations
methods.description: Returns the minimum number of allocations available.

methods.name: Capacity
methods.description: Returns the maximum number of entries (capacity) of the block file.

methods.name: ValidateCounters
methods.description: Validates the consistency of counters in the block header.

methods.name: FileId
methods.description: Returns the identifier of the current file.

methods.name: NextFileId
methods.description: Returns the identifier of the next file in the chain.

methods.name: Size
methods.description: Returns the size of the block file header.

methods.name: Header
methods.description: Returns a pointer to the block file header.

methods.name: Init
methods.description: Initializes the block files, optionally creating new files.

methods.name: GetFile
methods.description: Retrieves the mapped file corresponding to a given address.

methods.name: CreateBlock
methods.description: Creates a new block of a specified type and size, returning its address.

methods.name: DeleteBlock
methods.description: Deletes a block at a given address, optionally zeroing out its data and removing the file if empty.

methods.name: CloseFiles
methods.description: Closes all open block files.

methods.name: IsValid
methods.description: Checks if a given address points to a valid and used block.

methods.name: CreateBlockFile
methods.description: Creates a new block file with specified index and type.

methods.name: OpenBlockFile
methods.description: Opens an existing block file and validates its header.

methods.name: GrowBlockFile
methods.description: Grows the size of a block file if needed.

methods.name: FileForNewBlock
methods.description: Finds or creates a suitable file for allocating a new block.

methods.name: NextFile
methods.description: Returns the next file in the chain, creating it if necessary.

methods.name: CreateNextBlockFile
methods.description: Creates a new block file with the next available index.

methods.name: RemoveEmptyFile
methods.description: Removes chain links to empty files.

methods.name: FixBlockFileHeader
methods.description: Fixes and validates the header of a block file, repairing inconsistencies.

methods.name: Name
methods.description: Generates the filename for a block file based on its index.
